chunks: The second time for Maghrib is before the disappearance of the twilight.
From him, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Jabalah, from Dharīḥ, from Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام.
That Jibrāʾīl عليه السلام came to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم in...

key_terms.ٱلنَّبِيَّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.ٱلْمَغْرِبِ: the Maghrib prayer or its time at sunset
key_terms.ٱلْوَقْتِ: the prescribed time or timing under discussion

ai.seo_question: Until when does the time of Maghrib prayer remain valid before the twilight disappears?
ai.summary: This report concerns the timing of Maghrib prayer and indicates a legal discussion about its valid period before the disappearance of twilight. The narration is transmitted from Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام and begins a report involving Jibrāʾīl عليه السلام coming to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم.
